frame: BRIEF world frame: origin = centre of inside face of street-door threshold; +Y into the house, +X to the right walking in; Z up, world Z = 0 at the ground-floor finished floor. All floorZ / ceilingZ / baseZ / roof z are world Z.

conventions.polygon: inside wall faces, counter-clockwise; projections (piers, pilasters, chimney breast, boxing) are in features, not in the polygon
conventions.size: nominal main rectangle [x, y] for labels
conventions.walls: centreline a->b with thickness; rooms = [left, right] of a->b; baseZ + height = vertical extent (world); 'void' = solid ground / shaft / unseen zone; roomsBelow = rooms of the level below that an opening in this wall may connect; virtual walls (thickness 0) are open room boundaries (risers, balustrades)
conventions.hinge: side of the hinges seen from inside the room the leaf swings into (swingInto), facing the door; hingeAt = hinge jamb point on the centreline; openAngle = state to model
conventions.heights: opening height is the clear height above sill; transom.height = top of the fanlight above floor
conventions.reconcile: spec/RECONCILE.md (ground floor, phase 1) and spec/RECONCILE2.md (phase 2); validate with python spec/validate_house2.py
conventions.level: every room, wall, opening, feature and stairs flight has level B | G | 1 | 2; split levels are different floorZ within one level
conventions.room.kind: room | stairwell (plan region of a flight, exempt from stacking) | void (eaves storage bounded by roof planes) | exterior (balcony)
conventions.ceiling: ceilingZ = highest ceiling (world Z). Optional ceilingZones [{polygon, z}] lower parts of it; optional ceiling {type: planes, planes: [{polygon, z: {c0, cx, cy}}]} gives world z = c0 + cx*x + cy*y; {type: under_roof, offset} = roof surface + offset
conventions.openings: sill and height are above floorZ (world Z of the floor the opening is measured from); step = level change through a passable opening; transomBar = height of a transom bar above floorZ; sashes = which lights open and how (optional handle: 'bottom' = brass lever centred on the bottom rail); outsideZone = exterior zone a door opens onto; type hatch = eaves door pair
conventions.chamfer: feature type chamfer: face = plan line of a diagonal (about 45 degree) wall face that is an edge of the room polygon; z = extent
conventions.arch: feature type arch: springing / crown above the opening's floorZ; optional haunch = radius of the two haunch circles of a three-centred arch (else one segmental arc)
conventions.stairs: list of flights; risers x rise = toZ - fromZ exactly; kind steps = 1-2 risers inside a level (riserLines); above = flight directly over this one
conventions.exterior: plot, zones (polygon + surface z), steps, boundaries, features, buildings (shed), envelope (outer faces per block and level, contiguous in z), facades (plane + ids of the openings in it)
conventions.roof: planes: polygon in plan + z = c0 + cx*x + cy*y of the outer surface; structure.thickness below it is the ceiling plane
conventions.stairs.walk: flights: walk = {polygon (plan footprint), risers (ordered lines [[ax,ay],[bx,by]], far side towards toRoom on the left of a->b), ends [{room, opening}]}; winders.risers repeat the winder lines with their riser number n
conventions.zones: room = pseudo-room that owns the zone / boundary (front | side_passage | garden | shed | neighbours); walk false = not walkable; fall {from, to, z: [z0, z1]}: surface z at p = z0 + t (z1 - z0), t = clamp(dot(p - from, to - from) / |to - from|^2, 0, 1); zone.z = z0
conventions.buildings: room = pseudo-room of the building; its walls / openings have level X and the same fields as house walls / openings; rooms = [left, right] of a->b
conventions.extReveal: optional per exterior opening: metres from the outer wall face to the outside of the frame (default rule: blender/MULTILEVEL.md section 3)
